item.title: VHDL's Crown Jewel
item.description:
📝 A delta cycle starts with a number of signal value updates. In these processes, signals assignments may occur that schedule value updates in the next delta cycle. The point of the delta cycle algorithm is that signal value updates and process evaluations are kept in separate sets.

item.title: AI and bots have officially taken over the internet
item.description:
📝 Key PointsA new report found that bots have surpassed human internet traffic. HUMAN Security's State of AI Traffic report found that automated traffic grew eight times faster than human traffic year-over-year. That automated traffic across the internet grew almost eight times faster than human activity in 2025, according to the report.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/26/ai-bots-humans-internet.html
